purpose: Minimum automated security controls required before a Shine application can claim baseline Shine Defence protection.

badge.label: Protected by Shine Defence
badge.rule: The release revision must pass every required control in its local baseline-v1 certification profile.

requirements.name: Baseline browser security headers are emitted
Static file paths are constrained to the application root
Remote data fetches use deadlines and response-size limits
Untrusted local file imports have format-specific parser protections and size limits
External new-tab links isolate the opener
Application source is checked for obvious committed secret material
